question: Yellow journalism
options: Sensationalist journalism that exaggerates news for readership
To be a very truthful journalist
To write stories about nature
To report only positive news
solution: Yellow journalism often uses shocking headlines instead of facts. सनसनीखेज और भ्रामक पत्रकारिता जिसमें खबरों को बहुत बढ़ा-चढ़ा कर पेश किया जाता है।

question: Yeoman service
options: To serve someone with bad intentions
To work as a guard in a palace
Very good useful and loyal service
To perform a very simple task
solution: The local NGO provided yeoman service during the floods. बहुत ही उत्कृष्ट और निस्वार्थ सेवा प्रदान करना।

question: You can say that again
options: Used to show you strongly agree with what someone said
To complain about a loud noise
To ask someone to repeat a word
To speak very clearly and slowly
solution: "This movie is a masterpiece." "You can say that again!" किसी की बात से पूरी तरह सहमत होना।

question: Your guess is as good as mine
options: To be very smart at solving puzzles
To share a secret with a friend
Used to say that you do not know the answer to a question
To win a competition by guessing
solution: "Will it rain today?" "Your guess is as good as mine." मुझे भी उतना ही पता है जितना आपको (यानी मुझे भी नहीं पता)।

question: Yellow-bellied
options: Cowardly; lacking courage
To be extremely wealthy
To be very jealous of others
To be very energetic and active
solution: A yellow-bellied person is easily frightened and lacks bravery. वह व्यक्ति जो डरपोक या कायर हो।
